validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="done"/></state>
  <state id="island">
    <state id="stuck"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

notes: its descendant state is unreachable as well and is not reported separately
reachability assumes every event can arrive and every `cond` can be true; no reachable transition, `initial`, or history default enters this state or any of its descendants
diagnostics.help: target `island` from a transition of a reachable state, make it the initial state of the <scxml> root, or remove it
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
